supporting_news.title: Indian bonds steady after RBI minutes signal more rate hikes
supporting_news.summary: Indian bond yields remain steady at approximately 7.45%, influenced by growing inflation anxieties. The Reserve Bank of India recently increased the repo rate to 5.50%, hinting that further hikes may follow. With climbing oil prices and food inflation heightening economic concerns, analysts speculate another increase may occur in December, before a potential pause. The elevated energy costs pose significant challenges for India's economy, affecting the rupee and government finances.

supporting_news.title: Rupee snaps eight-day rally as oil climbs to highest since May
supporting_news.summary: The Indian rupee ended its eight-session-long winning streak, closing down 0.4% at 94.8175 per dollar. Concerns over escalating oil prices amid the Middle East conflict contributed to global market volatility. Brent oil prices reached $112.40 per barrel, impacting India's economy due to high crude imports. The Reserve Bank of India faced pressure on whether to defend the currency amid these pressures.

supporting_news.title: Global Market: Japanese bond yields fall to multiweek lows ahead of BOJ meeting
supporting_news.summary: Japanese government bond yields fell to multiweek lows on Thursday as geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns boosted safe-haven demand. The 10-year yield dropped to 2.88%, while investors awaited the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting, with markets weighing potential rate hikes and global economic uncertainties.
